excludedRelations._prisma_migrations: Prisma's migration ledger is written only by the migration operator; the runtime role must have no access.
excludedRelations.playing_with_neon: Neon sample/legacy table is not referenced by DigitalGate runtime code; explicitly excluded with zero runtime privileges while all other unknown tables remain rejected.

operatorOnly.reason: One-time #991 schema remediation requires table locks, DDL and the migration ledger. It must run with separate owner/operator authority, never the runtime role.
Reviewed #991 remediation SQL parser is part of the owner-only schema operation.
Generated #991 DDL is owner-only and excluded from runtime SQL analysis.
Signed legacy reconciliation is an operator-only billing repair path; runtime tables it touches remain granted for normal billing operations.
